attributes.residual: NAMED MECHANISM, one word, do-not-retry on declaration order and on initializer-group promotion. regnorm: 173 paired, 54 renaming, 1 STRUCTURAL, 0 unpaired. The word is @0x00ec, target `mr r26,r27`, ours `addi r26,r28,0` -- both encode the same copy bitBytes <- indices for the source statement `bitBytes = indices;`, at identical position in an otherwise structurally identical stream (every other row is `=` or an opcode-only register rename). `mr rD,rS` is `or rD,rS,rS`; `addi rD,rS,0` is the address-path encoding; MWCC chooses between them internally and this function shows it choosing BOTH within one prologue for reasons no source property explains (0x10 `mr r20,r3` for the first pointer parameter, 0x14 `addi r24,r6,0` for an int parameter, 0x18 `addi r21,r7,0` for a pointer parameter -- and target and ours AGREE on all three). WEBFRANK IS RULED OUT BY THE CLASS'S OWN PRECONDITIONS, not by a guess: equivalent_copy_form's `unconditional` mode requires our word and the target word to decode as the SAME copy rD<-rS, and here the SOURCE registers differ (r28 vs r27) because the whole function still needs recoloring; the stage runs BEFORE the recolor snapshot, and its per-word assert requires the rewrite to reach the target word, which `addi r26,r28,0` -> `mr r26,r28` does not. `dominating_def` needs ours to be `li rD,K` and it is not. Broadening the class is forbidden by the tool's constraints, so this is left for the composed-rule question recorded in the census law.
